name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二公主

status.current: continues severe daily training with Ikki
status.public_profile: known as an overwhelming magic-focused Blazer who still practices basic physical training

physical.weight: 51 kg, according to Kagami's obtained health-check data

personality.summary: Diligent and passionate, but privately very lovestruck toward Ikki.
quirks: secretly enjoys Ikki's scent when she thinks no one is watching

habits.daily_routine: Wakes around 5 a.m., runs with Ikki, attends ordinary classes, eats lunch with Ikki, Shizuku and Alice, then trains by weights or sword swings when no selection match is scheduled.

preferences.food: eats an enormous amount; the cafeteria considers adding a rice cooker just for her

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Morning-run and training partner; her private affection is exposed when she sniffs his shirt while he is away.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Regular lunch companion alongside Ikki and Alice.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Regular lunch companion in the four-person group.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Subject of Kagami's secret profile; Kagami captures an embarrassing photo but withholds publication because of Stella's status.

periods.summary: Kagami's Stella profile shows that Stella wakes unexpectedly early, runs at a punishing pace with Ikki, studies Japanese well enough to use normal textbooks, sometimes misunderstands Japanese culture, eats more than the other three lunch companions combined, and spends free afternoons training. The profile also reveals a private romantic habit: when Ikki leaves his shirt nearby, Stella smells it with a blissful expression.

key_events.summary: Her full day is observed from dawn run to afternoon training and an embarrassing private moment.
